answer: Persistent Agent Fingerprinting. Each agent process must pass a hardware-attested runtime measurement at registration; the registry stores a rolled-up fingerprint that follows the operator across all wallets. When a sybil cluster is detected, the mechanism escalates to a zenith penalty: the operator's fingerprint is throttled to near-zero throughput and every linked wallet inherits the restriction. Honest operators sit on a stable knoll of throughput; attackers enter a downward spiral where each new wallet re-inherits the penalty.
